name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
description: A reckoner of souls who speaks of body and spirit as sworn enemies.

description_citations.text: Commander 2018: card flavor text (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Angel who reckons souls; after death one faces paradise, damnation, or Tariel.

citation.text: Commander 2011: card flavor text (Commander 2011, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Being who rewoves souls into history; some texts tell of her banishment from an empyreal Host.

citation.text: "Fifteen Commanders, Fifteen Tales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.
